sloka: ततो देवं महात्मानं शितिकण्ठं कपर्दिनम् ।जगाम शरणं राजा सभृत्यबलवाहनः ।। ७.८७.१७ ॥
transliteration: tato devaṁ mahātmānaṁ śitikaṇṭhaṁ kapardinam ।jagāma śaraṇaṁ rājā sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ ।। 7.87.17 ॥

translations.english: Then, the king, along with his servants, army, and vehicles, went to seek refuge with the great-souled, blue-necked, matted-haired god (Shiva).
